3 . As could be seen from the above, the allegations against the petitioners are that they had submitted a false caste certificate and secured aid of Rs.25,000/- each.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that there is absolutely no material to indicate that the petitioners had submitted false caste certificate.
He also submits that there is no material produced to show that the amounts were actually disbursed to the petitioners.
5. In my view these are the contentions which cannot be examined under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. I find no grounds to entertain the petition and the petition is accordingly dismissed.
